# FieldKit instructions for GitHub Copilot

Follow the repository-wide rules in `AGENTS.md`.

Choose the relevant independent action: `.agents/skills/ask-speckle/SKILL.md` for an
evidenced answer, `.agents/skills/build-with-speckle/SKILL.md` for a bounded artefact,
or `.agents/skills/delegate-with-speckle/SKILL.md` for repeatable work performed on a
user's behalf. Do not invent project, organisation or regulatory practice.
